# EngVox

> EngVox is an AI-powered engineering English platform, teaching
> discipline-specific vocabulary, grammar, and communication for 10
> engineering fields. Free plan available, no credit card required.

EngVox helps engineers and technical professionals master the vocabulary,
grammar, and writing conventions used in their specific discipline —
including FIDIC-style contract writing — through AI-driven coaching and
adaptive lessons.

## Product

- [Home](https://engvox.com/): Overview of the platform and its free plan.
- [Pricing](https://engvox.com/pricing): Plans and pricing for individuals.
- [Business](https://engvox.com/business): Team and organization plans.
- [Get started](https://engvox.com/start): Begin the free placement flow.
